name: aioredis
guidance: Use redis.asyncio for aioredis 2-style code; aioredis merged into redis-py in 4.2.0rc1. The 1.x pool API is not interchangeable. Check connection cleanup with aclose(), pub/sub, and response decoding. The floor here is for researched redis 8.1.0.

name: appdirs
guidance: The maintained fork retains AppDirs as an alias; change module imports to platformdirs. Corrected paths and environment handling can change storage locations: test each OS and migrate existing data where needed. The floor is for platformdirs 4.12.2.

name: argparse
guidance: Remove the backport requirement and keep import argparse. Check parser output and any reliance on backport-specific bug fixes on the lowest supported interpreter.

name: async-timeout
guidance: Use native timeout contexts when Python 3.11 is the minimum. Basic async-with usage is compatible; rewrite package-specific shift(), update(), or reject() calls using the native reschedule() API. Keep the backport for older interpreters.

name: asyncio
guidance: Remove the PyPI requirement and keep import asyncio. The current distribution is an obsolete empty stub; the standard library provides the implementation. This does not replace other asyncio ecosystem packages.

name: attrs
guidance: Requires code changes and a choice of model semantics. Dataclasses (3.7+) suit plain data classes but need explicit replacements for attrs validators, converters, factories, and hooks. Pydantic 2.13.5 (3.9+) suits validation boundaries; rewrite schemas, validation, and serialization and choose strictness explicitly. attrs remains maintained.

name: backports.datetime-fromisoformat
guidance: Remove MonkeyPatch.patch_fromisoformat() setup and call date, datetime, and time.fromisoformat directly. Version 2 backports the broader Python 3.11 parser: Python 3.7 is sufficient only for the narrower version 1 behavior.

name: backports.functools-lru-cache
guidance: Import lru_cache from functools instead of backports.functools_lru_cache. The recorded floor includes typed=True, added in Python 3.3; basic lru_cache exists in 3.2.

name: backports.shutil-get-terminal-size
guidance: Import get_terminal_size from shutil instead of backports.shutil_get_terminal_size. Check terminal detection and fallback dimensions in redirected and noninteractive environments.

name: backports.zoneinfo
guidance: Import ZoneInfo from zoneinfo. Keep tzdata where the system lacks an IANA timezone database, including typical Windows installations; removing the backport does not remove this data requirement.

name: black
guidance: Requires formatter configuration and CI changes: use ruff format, align target Python and formatting settings, and inspect a formatting-only diff. Ruff aims for Black compatibility but documents differences; do not alternate formatters on the same files. The installation floor is for Ruff 0.16.9.

name: cached-property
guidance: Suitable for plain synchronous cached_property on instances with a writable __dict__. Native cached_property does not provide the package's async Task caching, TTL, or threaded variants; its undocumented lock was removed in Python 3.12.

name: cdecimal
guidance: On CPython, import decimal instead of cdecimal: the C implementation was integrated in Python 3.3. Check numerical contexts and serialized results; this is not a performance guarantee for other Python implementations.

name: contextvars
guidance: Remove the backport requirement and keep import contextvars. Python 3.7 includes native asyncio integration; test context propagation through tasks and threads used by the application.

name: dataclasses
guidance: Remove the Python 3.6 backport requirement and keep imports from dataclasses when all supported runtimes are Python 3.7+. Newer decorator options still require their own Python version floors.

name: enum34
guidance: Remove enum34 and keep imports from enum. Check persisted enum values and string representations when upgrading the interpreter, especially IntEnum stringification changes in Python 3.11.

name: exceptiongroup
guidance: Use built-in exception group classes. Package catch() requires rewriting to except*; group-aware suppress() requires contextlib.suppress on Python 3.12.1+ for the backported behavior. Audit helper and traceback imports before removing the package.

name: flake8
guidance: Requires configuration and CI changes: map every selected rule and plugin to Ruff, translate exclusions and per-file ignores, and compare diagnostics. Ruff defaults do not enable every Flake8 rule; arbitrary Flake8 plugins are not loaded. Retain checks without equivalents. The installation floor is for Ruff 0.16.9.

name: fpdf
guidance: The maintained successor keeps from fpdf import FPDF. Do not coinstall fpdf and fpdf2: both own the fpdf namespace. Test rendering, font handling, and output consumers; modern output() returns bytearray. The floor is for fpdf2 2.8.9.

name: functools32
guidance: Use functools rather than functools32 for the Python 3.2 API backported to Python 2. Use a patched interpreter and verify any relied-on bug fixes; later functools APIs have later version floors.

name: futures
guidance: Remove the Python 2 backport requirement and keep concurrent.futures imports. Check executor lifecycle and multiprocessing platform behavior when upgrading the runtime.

name: fuzzywuzzy
guidance: The maintainers renamed the project: change imports to thefuzz. The initial 0.19 successor matched fuzzywuzzy 0.18, but current thefuzz uses RapidFuzz; test score thresholds, preprocessing, and ties before upgrading. The floor is for thefuzz 0.22.1.

name: importlib-metadata
guidance: Native metadata exists in 3.8, but this rolling backport can provide newer APIs. Selectable entry points and packages_distributions() need 3.10; compare every used API against the minimum interpreter before changing imports or removing the backport.

name: importlib-resources
guidance: Use native resources for the files()/Traversable API on 3.9+. Directory support in as_file() needs 3.12; newer backport APIs can require later interpreters. Audit all resource calls, including zipped packages, before removing the rolling backport.

name: ipaddress
guidance: Remove the backport and keep imports only after testing accepted address strings and classifications. Native IPv4 parsing rejects leading-zero octets from Python 3.9.5; is_private/is_global classifications have also changed, including in 3.13.

name: isort
guidance: Requires rule configuration and CI changes: enable Ruff I rules and use ruff check --select I --fix for import sorting. ruff format alone does not sort imports. Translate supported import-section settings and inspect differences; not every isort option is supported. The installation floor is for Ruff 0.16.9.

name: mock
guidance: Change imports to unittest.mock only after checking used APIs against the minimum interpreter: AsyncMock needs 3.8 and ThreadingMock needs 3.13. The separately maintained package can contain fixes and features newer than an older standard library.

name: more-itertools
guidance: Requires code changes and only covers these helpers: pairwise exists in 3.10; batched exists in 3.12 and returns tuples rather than chunked() lists. batched(strict=True) needs 3.13. Other more-itertools helpers are not replaced; remove the package only after inventorying every use.

name: mypy
guidance: Requires configuration, suppression, and CI changes: run ty alongside mypy, translate rules to tool.ty, and compare diagnostics and type inference. Review plugin-dependent checks and library support separately; strict modes and error codes are not equivalent. The installation floor is for ty 0.0.84.

name: pathlib
guidance: Remove the obsolete pathlib distribution and keep imports from pathlib. Check filesystem behavior on target platforms and verify newer methods against the minimum interpreter.

name: pathlib2
guidance: Change pathlib2 imports to pathlib. Python 3.4 provides the base module, but the backport tracks later enhancements; inventory used methods and test path handling on supported platforms before removing it.

name: pip
guidance: Requires workflow changes: choose uv pip for an existing requirements workflow, or uv add/lock/sync/run for a project workflow. Review indexes, credentials, constraints, environment selection, and resolver differences; uv does not invoke pip. The installation floor is for uv 0.12.20.

name: pip-tools
guidance: Requires workflow changes: map pip-compile/pip-sync to uv pip compile/sync, or migrate direct dependencies to pyproject.toml and use uv.lock. Preserve constraints, markers, extras, indexes, and hashes where required; compare resolved environments. The installation floor is for uv 0.12.20.

name: pycrypto
guidance: The maintained successor shares the Crypto namespace; do not coinstall the packages. It is nearly compatible, but removed public-key methods and explicit cipher-mode requirements need review. Test cryptographic formats and protocols. The floor is for PyCryptodome 3.23.0.

name: PyPDF2
guidance: The projects merged, continuing PyPDF2 3.x as pypdf 3.1+. Change imports to pypdf; older PdfFileReader/PdfFileWriter names and camelCase methods need rewrites. Current releases have further changes: test representative PDFs. The floor is for pypdf 6.19.0.

name: pyright
guidance: Requires configuration, suppression, editor, and CI changes: run ty alongside Pyright, map rules and source environments, and compare diagnostics before switching. Rewrite Pyright-specific ignore comments and review severity mappings; no blanket checking parity is claimed. The installation floor is for ty 0.0.84.

name: python-dateutil
guidance: Requires code changes and only covers a subset: datetime.fromisoformat() for a constrained ISO input contract, and ZoneInfo for IANA zones. Free-form parser.parse(), relativedelta, and rrule have no equivalent here. Native ISO parsing differs from isoparse(); retain dateutil if unsupported features are used.

name: pytz
guidance: Requires code changes: replace localize()/normalize() patterns, is_dst decisions, and timezone construction with ZoneInfo and fold-aware handling. Test DST gaps, overlaps, and arithmetic; fold is not a general inverse of is_dst. Keep tzdata where system timezone data is unavailable.

name: requests
guidance: Requires code changes: replace Session with httpx.Client, rewrite exceptions, adapters/transports, streaming, and raw body arguments. Configure redirect following and timeouts explicitly; async usage requires await and AsyncClient. Requests remains maintained. The floor is for HTTPX 0.28.1.

name: selectors34
guidance: Import selectors rather than selectors34 for the backported Python 3.4 API. Test event-loop integration and platform-specific selector availability.

name: simplejson
guidance: Requires code changes and behavior tests. Native json suits basic JSON; orjson 3.12.0 requires Python 3.10 and returns bytes. Preserve Decimal precision explicitly and rewrite use_decimal, for_json, custom hooks, and non-finite-number handling. Neither target covers every simplejson feature; retain it when those features are needed.

name: singledispatch
guidance: Import from functools. This floor covers both functions; singledispatch alone exists in 3.4. Union-type registration needs 3.11. Check features used from the evolving backport against the minimum interpreter.

name: sklearn
guidance: Replace the deprecated sklearn distribution name in dependency files with scikit-learn; keep import sklearn unchanged. Preserve the actual scikit-learn version constraint, not the wrapper version 0.0. This floor is for scikit-learn 1.9.1, not every historical release.

name: statistics
guidance: Remove the Python 2 backport of the Python 3.4 statistics module and keep import statistics. Verify numerical results and exception expectations when changing interpreter versions.

name: StrEnum
guidance: Suitable for explicit string-valued members after an import change. Package StrEnum preserves member names for auto(), while enum.StrEnum lowercases them: preserve wire values explicitly. Specialized case-conversion subclasses have no direct native replacement.

name: subprocess32
guidance: Import subprocess instead of subprocess32. Python 3.5 covers its run() API and Python 3.3 covers timeouts; on Python 3 the package already redirects to subprocess. Test process cleanup and platform behavior.

name: toml
guidance: Only for ordinary TOML 1.0 reading. Replace filename/text-stream load() calls with binary file objects; tomllib has no dump()/dumps(), custom _dict, or decoder hooks. Keep a writer or suitable parser when those features are needed.

name: tomli
guidance: Use import tomllib as tomli for TOML 1.0 parsing on Python 3.11+. Tomli 2.4+ supports TOML 1.1, while Python 3.14 tomllib supports 1.0; retain Tomli for 1.1 documents, older runtimes, or measured benefits from compiled wheels.

name: typing
guidance: Remove the obsolete typing distribution and keep imports from typing. This does not apply to typing-extensions, which supplies newer typing features on older supported interpreters.

name: ujson
guidance: Requires code changes: dumps() returns bytes, options differ, non-string keys need explicit handling, and non-finite floats serialize differently. Check large integers and all output consumers; no load()/dump() file helpers. Benchmark real payloads rather than assuming a speedup. The floor is for orjson 3.12.0.

name: uuid6
guidance: Use native UUID6/UUID7 generators after checking signatures, UUID subclasses, and ordering requirements. Do not replace package uuid8(): it uses a time-based layout unlike native uuid8(a, b, c). uuid1_to_uuid6() has no direct native counterpart.

name: zipp
guidance: Native zipfile.Path exists in 3.8, but this rolling backport includes later features and fixes. Its open() interface changed in 3.9; compare each used API against the lowest patched interpreter before removing zipp.
